DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY PLAINTIFF INTERIOR DESIGN SERVICES
ORDER RE: CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-17-2017 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO AUG-17-2017 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF INFORMS THE COURT THAT THE PARTIES REACHED AN AGREEMENT REGARDING PAYMENT. IF THE PLAINTIFF RECEIVES PAYMENT AND THE CHECK CLEARS PARTIES DO NOT HAVE TO APPEAR AT THE NEXT HEARING DATE AND THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS CASE SETTLED. PLAINTIFF INTERIOR DESIGN SERVICES IS PRESENT. REPRESENTED BY MATTHEW MCGUINNESS, PRESIDENT. DEFENDANT JUSTIN FARRELLY, INC IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PER PROGRESS REPORT OF JULY 17, 2017. NO APPEARANCES. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL; CLERK: J. BERTELSEN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
FILE DESTROYED PER ORDER SIGNED BY JUDGE SAMUEL FENG ON 12/1/2021 PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 68153.
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY INTERIOR DESIGN SERVICES AS TO DEFENDANT JUSTIN FARRELLY INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-17-2017 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
